Local Android compatibility/diagnostic build, upstream reqwest0.13.4. Android defaults to HTTP/1.1 (TLS/hostname verification unchanged, explicit protocol overrides retained). Decode Display includes source so RGB-lib does not discard JSON/body timeout cause. This is an unconfirmed workaround for device-only long proxy body read failures; host protocol1.0 probe already succeeds with HTTP1 and HTTP2. No remote service or wallet modifications.
